claim: MCBUL 5810 of 22 May 2024 is the governing authority for CJIS reporting
quote: Cancellation Contingency. This Bulletin is cancelled one year from the date of publication or when incorporated into reference (p), whichever occurs first.
fix: Check MCPEL for a replacement before relying on the bulletin. It carried a cancellation date of May 2025 and the page, verified 11 May 2026, cites it as live. Name the current directive or confirm incorporation into MCO 5580.6.

claim: Submit CJIS reports within 5 working days
quote: Notice shall be made in writing within five working days of the disposition.
fix: The CO notifies the servicing law enforcement agency in writing within 5 working days of the disposition. A unit with no servicing LEA emails CID at usmccid@ncis.navy.mil with the subject REQUEST FOR NICS ENTRY, also within 5 working days.

claim: CO directs the member to report to the servicing LEA within 5 working days of notification or disposition
quote: COs shall provide supporting documentation ... and direct a service member under their authority to report to the servicing LEA
fix: Two actions. The CO directs the member to report to the LEA and provides supporting documents. The CO also notifies the LEA in writing within 5 working days of the disposition. The clock starts at disposition, not at notification. In a deployed environment, direct the member to the LEA as soon as possible after redeployment.

claim: The S-1 officer signs by direction on routing of the supporting documentation
quote: COs shall provide supporting documentation (e.g., report of investigation, Unit Punishment Book)
fix: The bulletin puts the duty on the CO. Remove S-1 by direction signing or label it local routing.

claim: Categories: restraining order, DV conviction, Art 112a finding, GCM referral, GCM conviction over one year, incompetence or lack of mental responsibility, UA/deserter after preferral
quote: Is subject to charges referred to GCM ... Enters an unauthorized absence or deserter status following preferral of charges.

claim: Return from deserter status triggers no report
quote: d. Returns from deserter status.
fix: Add the fifth trigger: return from deserter status.

claim: Art 112a finding at NJP, SCM, SPCM or admin separation triggers the report

fix: Split permanent prohibitions (advise lawful disposal) from temporary ones (restraining order, wrongful drug use) where the CO is allowed to offer armory storage without access. Add the PMO escort step.

claim: Unit implements a procedure so a prohibited person does not access privately owned firearms in unit armories
quote: COs shall not permit access by a prohibited person to privately owned firearms stored in unit armories.

quote: COs shall not permit access by a prohibited person to privately owned firearms stored in unit armories.
fix: State the rule: no access. The mechanism list is local practice.
